_comment: The tracked source of truth for the viewer dashboard. outputs/ is gitignored and disposable; this file is not. Every viewer worth keeping has an entry here. Rebuild with: python3 scripts/viewers/viewerctl.py hub

groups.title: Dataset strata & sources
groups.blurb: What the model trains and evaluates on — one viewer per stratum, showing the clips as they actually are.

groups.title: Eval instrument & ladder
groups.blurb: The certified transition-eval harness, its certification records, and the ladder campaigns run through it.

groups.title: Experiment runs
groups.blurb: Per-run viewers generated next to their outputs. Only the newest run of each family is promoted here.

groups.title: Reports, decks & studies
groups.blurb: Written-up results, presentation material, and standalone instruments.

viewers.title: ctt_v2 corpora — refVFX + VFXMaster
viewers.blurb: Both external corpora along their counterfactual axes — same operator × many contents, same content × many operators. 153,758 samples, video read straight out of the WebDataset tars by byte range; nothing is extracted or copied.
viewers.notes: Static port of the app-server viewer on branch ctt-v2 (scripts/ctt_v2/dataset_viewer/, port 8799), verified at parity: identical sample counts, axis groups, group membership and row fields. The grouping serve.py did in memory is precomputed into range-addressable files; media URLs are range fetches into the shards. Page source is scripts/viewers/ctt_v2_corpora.html, linked in as index.html. Rebuild after data changes: python3 scripts/viewers/build_ctt_v2_corpora.py

viewers.title: S2 — procedural transition operators
viewers.blurb: The synthetic stratum of CTT v2: 7,990 clips from 42 shader operators. Landing page samples 42; browse walks every operator; retired shows the 420 blacklisted clips and why they went.

viewers.title: S3 — 3D depth-parallax transitions
viewers.blurb: All 203 depth-transition clips with the three generation mechanisms side by side, so the mechanism differences are visible rather than argued.

viewers.title: Luma-matte transitions — the map or the step()?
viewers.blurb: 114 clips isolating whether luma-matte behaviour comes from the matte source or from thresholding, with the maps shown next to the results.

viewers.title: D2 — final synthetic transition dataset
viewers.blurb: exp_077's D2 stratum: 252 ref/target pairs with filmstrips. Supersedes the D1 pilot.

viewers.title: HumanVid REAL (Pexels) — 60-clip sample
viewers.blurb: The real-footage subset, streamed straight from Pexels with source links. Needs internet in the browser; nothing is stored locally.

viewers.title: ladder2 — single reference of truth
viewers.blurb: The clean transition-eval campaign in one page: design, the seven seatbelts, leak-free prompt rendering, with inline examples. Authoritative over anything said in chat.

mount._why: eval_ladder/REFERENCE.html and DAVIS_SAMPLES.html climb ../../ for media, which overshoots the repo root by one level. The originals are the authoritative ladder2 record and stay untouched; these derived copies are re-made from source on every mount/serve, with the climb corrected.

viewers.title: eval ladder — results viewer
viewers.blurb: Every generated transition in the ladder2 campaign with its scores, filterable by cell, tier and ontology (1,902 clips).

viewers.title: IC-LoRA trainings — results
viewers.blurb: Every IC-LoRA training on one page, with a chip per run. ctt_v2 @ step 10,000 vs the ladder2 IC-LoRA generalist on 139 identical inputs, both rescored under the rebuilt 222-clip reference_v4, with the specialist and copier tiers alongside — plus the two external refVFX baseline arms (Ⓐ their prompt convention, Ⓑ our text budget) over the same grid, videos live and scores pending.

mount._why: Generated by eval_ladder/viewer/build_runs.py into outputs/reports/iclora_runs/. The page emits repo-root-relative media paths prefixed with meta.rel, and this mount sits at the same depth, so the prefix resolves identically. The links below make the same paths resolve from inside the viewer dir as well, matching the ladder2_results mount.

viewers._media: The two refvfx_baseline paths are symlinks into $LAB/misc/refvfx_baseline/{out,out_ours} — finished experimental data that is never moved or copied. build_runs.py recreates them on every run, so a wiped outputs/ costs one rerun. Scores for those arms land in $LAB/misc/refvfx_baseline/eval/<arm>/ and are picked up by the next rebuild.

viewers.title: Ladder v3 — paired side-by-side viewer
viewers.blurb: Certified v3.0.0 rows played in pairs, colour-coded GT / demo / floors, so a scored row can be checked against what it actually looks like (1,800 clips).

viewers.title: Certification record — transition-eval 3.0.0-draft.8
viewers.blurb: The certification run's own record (verdict, probes, siblings) plus the results explorer where six metrics sit the same exam over 3,174 clips.

viewers.title: Transition-eval harness · per-run viewer
viewers.blurb: The viewer the harness ships with every eval run — reads data.json from its own directory. Shown here on exp_058's quads.

viewers.title: Transition taxonomy v2 — validate
viewers.blurb: Click through 107 clips to confirm or reject their class assignment. The gating step for taxonomy work.

viewers.title: exp_083 — D3 pilot: depth-parallax 3D transitions
viewers.blurb: 109 clips with filmstrips from the D3 pilot. Newest run in the depth-3D line; earlier runs kept for comparison.

viewers.title: exp_075 — procedural transition operator engine
viewers.blurb: 73 operator demos with filmstrips: the engine that generates the S2 stratum, one card per operator.

viewers.title: Two weeks: from latent tricks to a certified instrument
viewers.blurb: The written progress report covering transition generation and the eval instrument. Self-contained — no media dependencies.

viewers.title: Week 2 — cross-ontology transition examples
viewers.blurb: Five-row deck of unseen and zero-shot cross-ontology cases, each with its inputs, its reference, and outputs at two seeds.

viewers.title: Blind 2AFC transition-comparison study
viewers.blurb: The frozen forced-choice instrument from the advised method-impl campaign (93 clips). Mounted read-only from misc/ — the original stays untouched so the blinding key holds.

viewers.title: Transition-hardness playground
viewers.blurb: Interactive scatter over the transition-hardness signals for shadow_smoke. Loads Plotly from a CDN, so it needs internet in the browser.

viewers.blurb: First synthetic stratum pilot.
